self_containment.mechanism: validate_contracts.py embeds the exact seeded transactional-result.schema.json bytes and parses that in-memory value; it performs no schema filesystem read at import or validation time.
self_containment.process_boundary: The regression test copies only validate_contracts.py into an owned scratch directory, executes it under python3 -I -B, validates one admissible and one schema-invalid document, and confirms no sibling or generated file exists.

schema_parity.assertion: The on-disk seeded schema bytes equal EMBEDDED_RESULT_SCHEMA_BYTES exactly, and parsing both yields RESULT_SCHEMA exactly.
schema_parity.effect: Any byte-level schema change or embedded-rule change fails the parity gate instead of silently creating a second contract.

remaining_boundary: An unreadable, syntactically corrupted, or Python-version-incompatible validator source can still fail during import before its own main() can print INVALID. Callers must treat any import or subprocess failure as a hard validation failure and must not swallow it. The parity guarantee also depends on running the committed test gate; an independently modified vendored copy must be content-hash verified.
